description:
The Youth and Eco Club scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2019. 

This initiative is part of the broader efforts to engage youth in environmental conservation and sustainable development. 

The scheme aims to create awareness among the youth about environmental issues. 

It seeks to empower them to take action towards a sustainable future. 

The primary objective of the Youth and Eco Club scheme is to establish eco clubs in schools and colleges across the country. 

The government aims to set up at least 10,000 eco clubs by the end of 2025. 

These clubs are intended to foster a sense of responsibility towards the environment among young people. 

The initiative also aims to promote activities that contribute to environmental conservation. 

The scheme encourages students to participate in various eco-friendly activities. 

These activities include tree plantation drives, cleanliness campaigns, and awareness programs. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme provides financial assistance to schools and colleges. 

Each eco club is eligible for a grant of up to INR 50,000. 

This funding can be used for organizing events and activities related to environmental awareness. 

The clubs are expected to conduct at least four major activities each year. 

These activities should focus on promoting sustainable practices among students. 

Eligibility for forming an eco club includes being a recognized educational institution. 

Both government and private schools and colleges can apply. 

There are no specific age limits for students to join these clubs. 

However, the primary focus is on engaging students from classes 6 to 12. 

The application process for establishing an eco club is straightforward. 

Institutions must submit a proposal to the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. 

The proposal should outline the objectives and planned activities of the eco club. 

Required documents include the institution's registration certificate and a detailed activity plan. 

Once the proposal is approved, the institution will receive the grant amount. 

The timeline for the application process varies but typically takes about three months. 

Institutions are encouraged to apply as soon as possible to secure funding. 

The disbursement of funds usually occurs within 30 days of approval. 

The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change oversees the implementation of this scheme. 

Contact details for the ministry can be found on their official website. 

They provide resources and guidelines for institutions interested in forming eco clubs. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme is part of India's commitment to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. 

It aligns with Goal 13, which focuses on climate action, and Goal 15, which emphasizes life on land. 

The scheme also aims to enhance the knowledge and skills of youth in environmental management. 

By 2023, over 2,000 eco clubs had already been established across various states. 

These clubs have engaged thousands of students in environmental activities. 

The government has reported a positive response from educational institutions. 

Many schools have integrated eco clubs into their curriculum. 

The scheme also promotes collaboration with local communities. 

This collaboration helps in addressing local environmental issues effectively. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme encourages students to become leaders in environmental advocacy. 

Students are trained to organize awareness campaigns and workshops. 

They are also encouraged to participate in national and international environmental events. 

The scheme has received funding from the National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change. 

This fund supports various initiatives aimed at climate resilience. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme is expected to contribute significantly to India's climate goals. 

The government aims to increase youth participation in environmental governance. 

This includes involving them in policy-making processes related to environmental issues. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of research and innovation in environmental conservation. 

Students are encouraged to undertake projects that address local environmental challenges. 

The government provides mentorship and guidance to students undertaking such projects. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme has the potential to create a generation of environmentally conscious citizens. 

It aims to instill a sense of stewardship towards the environment among young people. 

The scheme also promotes the use of technology in environmental monitoring. 

Students are encouraged to use digital tools for data collection and analysis. 

This approach helps in raising awareness about environmental issues in a more engaging manner. 

The government regularly evaluates the progress of the eco clubs. 

Feedback from participating institutions is used to improve the scheme. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme is a significant step towards sustainable development in India. 

It empowers youth to take charge of their environment and promotes community involvement. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on environmental conservation efforts in the country. 

Overall, the Youth and Eco Club scheme is a comprehensive initiative. 

It combines education, community engagement, and environmental stewardship. 

The government remains committed to supporting youth-led initiatives for a sustainable future. 

This scheme is a vital component of India's environmental policy framework. 

It reflects the government's recognition of the role of youth in shaping a sustainable world. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme is an opportunity for students to make a difference. 

It encourages them to be proactive in addressing environmental challenges. 

The initiative aims to create a culture of sustainability among the younger generation. 

Through this scheme, the government hopes to inspire a collective effort towards a greener future. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme is a testament to India's commitment to environmental education. 

It highlights the importance of youth engagement in achieving sustainable development goals. 

The scheme is expected to evolve and expand in the coming years. 

The government is exploring partnerships with NGOs and international organizations. 

These partnerships aim to enhance the effectiveness of the eco clubs. 

The Youth and Eco Club scheme is a forward-thinking initiative. 

It recognizes the importance of involving youth in environmental conservation efforts. 

The scheme is a call to action for young people to take responsibility for their planet.
